topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: I was just doing some routine maintenance, taking a look up in the attic, when I stumbled across a veritable hoard of junk. Old, dusty board games, broken furniture, and clothing that looks like it belonged in a thrift store's reject pile. These weren't my things; they clearly belonged to the previous owners. I mean, who leaves all this stuff behind like it’s someone else’s problem? Now I’m the one who has to sort through this mess, make decisions on what to do with it all. I've got better things to do with my weekend. And don't even get me started on the dust. Great. Just great.
